audit_label.definition: Observable evidence is insufficient to assign one of the six supervised classes.

supervised_classes.definition: Ordinary mock-exam behavior without a review-worthy observable event.
Writing, scratching, stretching, or posture adjustment that may resemble head or shoulder movement.
Observable sustained downward head orientation without inferring an object or intent.
Observable sustained lateral head orientation without inferring intent.
No usable person is visible after the locked quality and persistence policy.
More than one usable pose is visible after the locked quality and persistence policy.

technical_outcome.definition: Camera, pose, focus, encoder, disk, schema, or evidence quality cannot support a behavior result.
